verses.gurmukhi: ਆਈ ਪਾਪਣਿ ਪੂਤਨਾ ਦੁਹੀ ਥਣੀ ਵਿਹੁ ਲਾਇ ਵਹੇਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: aaiee paapan pootanaa dhuhee thanee vih lai vahelee|

en.bdb: The ill-reputed Putana applied poison on both of her teats.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਬੈਠੀ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨੇਹੁੰ ਲਾਇ ਨਵਹਾਣਿ ਨਵੇਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: aai baiThee paravaar vich nehu(n) lai navahaan navelee|

en.bdb: She came to the family (of Nand) and started to express her newfound love for the family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਛੜਿ ਲਏ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਚੇਟਕੁ ਚਤੁਰੰਗ ਮਹੇਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: kuchhaR le govi(n)dh rai kar cheTak chatura(n)g mahelee|

en.bdb: Through her clever deception, she lifted Krishna in her lap.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਣੁ ਮੰਮੇ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਆਈ ਗਰਬ ਗਹੇਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: mohan ma(n)me paion baahar aaiee garab gahelee|

en.bdb: With great pride she pressed her breast teat in the mouth of Krishna and came out.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਵਧਾਇ ਉਚਾਇਅਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਚਰਿਆਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਅਠਿਖੇਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: dheh vadhai uchaian teh chariaar naar aThikhelee|

en.bdb: Now she expanded her body to a great extent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹੁੰ ਲੋਆਂ ਦਾ ਭਾਰੁ ਦੇ ਚੰਬੜਿਆ ਗਲਿ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: tihu(n) loaa(n) dhaa bhaar dhe cha(n)baRiaa gal hoi dhuhelee|

en.bdb: Krishna also becoming the full weight of the three worlds hung from and stuck to her neck.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਇ ਪਛਾੜ ਪਹਾੜ ਵਾਂਗਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਈ ਓਜਾੜਿ ਧਕੇਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: khai pachhaaR pahaaR vaa(n)g jai piee ojaaR dhakelee|

en.bdb: Getting unconscious, and like a mountain she fell down into the forest.
Krishna liberated her at last and gave her status of equal to his mother’s friend.
